description: Live-verified strictness rules: temporal functions reject a declared-VARCHAR column (a bare string constant is refused too, while an explicit cast and a real TIMESTAMP column work, and a derived value stays coercible), VALUES rejects a string literal for a semi-structured column (PARSE_JSON through SELECT is the way in), masking-policy attachment rules are enforced (a policy in use cannot be dropped, one policy per column, a masked column cannot be a policy argument), task cron schedules are validated (field count and a mandatory time zone), and a lateral table function cannot take an ON predicate while a lateral subquery can. Converted 1:1 from features/SnowflakeStrictnessRulesTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE tf_v (d VARCHAR, ts TIMESTAMP)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', '2024-04-08'::DATE)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', '2024-04-08')
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', d) FROM tf_v
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', d::DATE) FROM tf_v
SELECT LEFT(TO_VARCHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', ts)), 10) FROM tf_v
WITH t AS (SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AS end_time) SELECT DATEDIFF(millisecond, '2024-01-01', end_time) >= 0 FROM t
CREATE TABLE ss (v VARIANT)
INSERT INTO ss VALUES ('{"a": 1}')
INSERT INTO ss SELECT PARSE_JSON('{"a": 1}')
SELECT v:a FROM ss
CREATE MASKING POLICY sp_m1 AS (v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR -> '***'
CREATE TABLE sp_t (secret VARCHAR, other VARCHAR)
ALTER TABLE sp_t ALTER COLUMN secret SET MASKING POLICY sp_m1
DROP MASKING POLICY sp_m1
ALTER TABLE sp_t ALTER COLUMN secret SET MASKING POLICY sp_m1
CREATE MASKING POLICY sp_m3 AS (v VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR -> '###'
ALTER TABLE sp_t ALTER COLUMN secret SET MASKING POLICY sp_m3
CREATE MASKING POLICY sp_m2 AS (v VARCHAR, s VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR -> '***'
ALTER TABLE sp_t ALTER COLUMN other SET MASKING POLICY sp_m2 USING (other, secret)
ALTER TABLE sp_t ALTER COLUMN secret UNSET MASKING POLICY
DROP MASKING POLICY sp_m1
CREATE WAREHOUSE sp_wh
CREATE TASK sp_bad WAREHOUSE = sp_wh SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON * * * UTC' AS SELECT 1
CREATE TASK sp_bad2 WAREHOUSE = sp_wh SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 * * * *' AS SELECT 1
CREATE TASK sp_ok WAREHOUSE = sp_wh SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 9 * * MON America/Los_Angeles' AS SELECT 1
CREATE TASK sp_min WAREHOUSE = sp_wh SCHEDULE = '5 MINUTE' AS SELECT 1
DROP WAREHOUSE IF EXISTS sp_wh
CREATE TABLE lt (id INTEGER, tags VARIANT)
INSERT INTO lt SELECT 1, PARSE_JSON('["a","b"]')
SELECT t.id, f.value FROM lt t JOIN LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => t.tags) f ON TRUE
SELECT t.id FROM lt t JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 AS k) l ON TRUE
SELECT t.id, f.value FROM lt t, LATERAL FLATTEN(INPUT => t.tags) f
SELECT t.id FROM lt t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 AS k) l
